description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the ChangeVideoSize operation in the video production (videoenhan) category
description_zh: 本文介绍视频生产（videoenhan）类目下的视频画幅变换ChangeVideoSize的语法及示例
name: ChangeVideoSize

parameters.help_en: The video URL. Use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS URLs in regions other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The width of the output video. Unit: pixels. Valid values: 32 to 2160
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频的宽度，单位像素，取值范围32~2160
parameters.name: width

parameters.help_en: The height of the output video. Unit: pixels. Valid values: 32 to 2160
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频的高度，单位像素，取值范围32~2160
parameters.name: height

parameters.help_en:
The cropping method. Valid values:

smart: Intelligent cropping. Intelligently determines whether to pad or crop based on the position of the main subject, or applies a combination of padding and cropping.

fill: Padding. Adjusts the aspect ratio based on the longest side, and pads the excess area with a blurred background or color, or stretches the video.

cut: Cropping. Adjusts the aspect ratio based on the shortest side, and crops the excess area
parameters.help_zh:
裁剪方式，可选smart、fill、cut。具体含义如下所示。

`smart`（智能裁剪）：根据主体位置智能决定填充还是裁剪，或者填充一部分，裁切一部分。

`fill`（填充）：按最长边进行画幅调整，超出部分填充模糊背景或颜色，或者进行拉伸处理。

`cut`（裁剪）：按最短边进行画幅调整，超出部分裁剪掉
parameters.name: crop_type

parameters.help_en:
The padding method. Valid values:

image: Pads the video with the content of a middle frame, which is blurred before padding.

color: Pads the video with a specified color. The value is an array of RGB values, such as [255,0,0] for red. 

stretch: Pads the video by stretching. Avoid using this method because a large aspect ratio adjustment may cause severe distortion
parameters.help_zh:
填充方式。包括image、color、stretch。具体含义如下所示。

image：填充视频中间一帧的内容，填充前进行模糊处理。

color：指定填充颜色，表示RGB值的数组，例如红色`[255,0,0]`。 

stretch：通过拉伸进行填充。如果画幅调整比例较大会导致画面扭曲严重，不推荐使用。
parameters.name: fill_type

parameters.help_en: The compactness of the cropping box. Valid values: 0 to 1. A larger value indicates that more content is cropped. Default value: 0.6
parameters.help_zh: 裁切框的紧凑度，取值范围0~1。值越大裁掉的内容越多。默认值为0.6
parameters.name: tightness

parameters.help_en: The R value in the RGB color model. This parameter is required when FillType is set to color
parameters.help_zh: 当FillType取值为`color`时需要设置。表示RGB值中R的取值
parameters.name: r

parameters.help_en: The G value in the RGB color model. This parameter is required when FillType is set to color
parameters.help_zh: 当FillType取值为`color`时需要设置。表示RGB值中G的取值
parameters.name: g

parameters.help_en: The B value in the RGB color model. This parameter is required when FillType is set to color
parameters.help_zh: 当FillType取值为`color`时需要设置。表示RGB值中B的取值
parameters.name: b

Data.description_en: The returned data. To obtain this data after the asynchronous task is executed successfully, invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and use JSON deserialization to deserialize the Result field
Data.description_zh: 返回的数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

VideoCoverUrl.description_en:
The URL of the output video cover.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after it expires. To store the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
VideoCoverUrl.description_zh:
输出视频封面URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

VideoUrl.description_en:
The URL of the output video.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after it expires. To store the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
VideoUrl.description_zh:
输出视频URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The prompt message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
